_note: Migrated from knowledge-base/rules/indian_law_enforcement.rules.json, which declared 16 enforcement rules and stated that 'the IRE engine checks these rules during generation and validation' -- but was loaded by nothing. In this constraints file they actually run. They are admitted as notice_only pending review: switching 8 CRITICAL blocking rules on at once would refuse documents that generate today.

rules.description: Employment contracts must address EPF contributions. Criminal liability for employer under EPF Act S.14 if EPF is not deducted.
rules.statutory_reference: Employees' Provident Funds and Miscellaneous Provisions Act, 1952 – S.6
rules.remedy: Include EMP_BENEFITS_001 or an equivalent clause addressing this requirement.

rules.description: Salary must not be below applicable minimum wages. Employer faces criminal prosecution for below-minimum wages.
rules.remedy: Include EMP_WAGES_001 or an equivalent clause addressing this requirement.

rules.description: Employment contracts must include a disciplinary procedure providing opportunity to be heard before adverse action. Violation is grounds for reinstatement.
rules.statutory_reference: Industrial Employment (Standing Orders) Act, 1946; Constitution Art.21
rules.remedy: Include EMP_DISCIPLINARY_ACTION_001 or an equivalent clause addressing this requirement.

rules.description: Employment contracts must address maternity benefits. Denial of maternity leave is a criminal offence under MBA S.21.
rules.remedy: Include EMP_LEAVE_POLICY_001 or an equivalent clause addressing this requirement.

rules.description: Service agreements must address TDS deduction. Payment clause must specify whether S.194C (contracts, 2%) or S.194J (professional, 10%) applies.
rules.remedy: Include SERVICE_PAYMENT_001 or an equivalent clause addressing this requirement.

rules.description: Payment clause must require GST-compliant tax invoices with GSTIN, SAC/HSN code, and GST amount. Non-compliant invoices block input tax credit.
rules.statutory_reference: Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 – S.31
rules.remedy: Include SERVICE_PAYMENT_001 or an equivalent clause addressing this requirement.

rules.description: Loan agreements must address TDS on interest under S.194A (10% TDS when interest > Rs.40,000 p.a. for resident individuals).
rules.remedy: Include LOAN_INTEREST_001 or an equivalent clause addressing this requirement.

rules.description: Interest rate in loan agreement must not be usurious. Courts may reduce interest rates above commercially reasonable levels.
rules.remedy: Include LOAN_INTEREST_001 or an equivalent clause addressing this requirement.

rules.description: Leases for a term exceeding 12 months must be compulsorily registered. Unregistered leases are inadmissible as evidence under Registration Act S.49.
rules.remedy: Include PROP_REGISTRATION_001 or an equivalent clause addressing this requirement.

rules.description: Rental and lease agreements must be executed on adequately stamped paper. Unstamped instruments are inadmissible under Indian Stamp Act S.35.
rules.statutory_reference: Indian Stamp Act, 1899 – S.3; State Stamp Acts
rules.remedy: Include CORE_IDENTITY_001 or an equivalent clause addressing this requirement.

rules.description: Where annual rent exceeds Rs.2,40,000, the tenant must deduct TDS at 10% on commercial rent (S.194I). Rent payment clause should address TDS obligations.
rules.remedy: Include RENTAL_RENT_PAYMENT_001 or an equivalent clause addressing this requirement.

rules.description: Shareholders Agreement cannot override Companies Act provisions, MoA or AoA. Any SHA provision inconsistent with Companies Act is void.
rules.remedy: Include CORE_COMPLIANCE_WITH_LAW_001 or an equivalent clause addressing this requirement.

rules.description: Copyright assignment must be in writing and signed by the assignor (Copyright Act S.19). Service agreements must include written IP assignment — unlike employment, contractor IP does NOT auto-vest in client.
rules.remedy: Include IP_OWNERSHIP_001 or an equivalent clause addressing this requirement.

rules.description: Arbitration clause must specify the seat of arbitration. Without seat, Part I vs Part II applicability is ambiguous and Indian courts may lack supervisory jurisdiction.
rules.statutory_reference: Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 – S.20; BALCO v Kaiser Aluminium (SC)
rules.remedy: Include CORE_DISPUTE_RESOLUTION_001 or an equivalent clause addressing this requirement.

rules.description: NDAs involving listed companies or their advisors must explicitly address UPSI obligations under SEBI PIT Regulations 2015.
rules.statutory_reference: SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015 – Regulation 3
rules.remedy: Include CORE_COMPLIANCE_WITH_LAW_001 or an equivalent clause addressing this requirement.

rules.description: All contracts must be executed on adequately stamped paper. Stamp duty varies by document type, value and state. Unstamped instruments are inadmissible (S.35).
rules.statutory_reference: Indian Stamp Act, 1899 – S.3; State Stamp Acts
rules.remedy: Include CORE_SIGNATURE_BLOCK_001 or an equivalent clause addressing this requirement.
